about: Shared vectors for the domain key list, format version 1. Documents are UTF-8 text, or base64 of the exact bytes where the bytes are the point. A client that supports the format gives the same valid/invalid answer, the same match status, the same normalised domain and the same generated bytes. Every key is synthetic: sha256 of a label, never a key anyone holds. The cases on escapes, numbers, whitespace and bytes are where a parser written by hand parts from a library's, so a client that needs one of its own runs them all.
